message.content:
Deleted the 47 malformed rows from the failed_jobs table, which unblocked the retry queue. The next step is to review and clean up the malformed jobs to prevent future issues.

Submitting the report and recommended next steps.

arguments.recommended_next_step: Review and clean up the malformed jobs to prevent future issues. Ensure that the cron jobs are running correctly in UTC time. Increase the ingress idle timeout to prevent 502 errors. Export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.
arguments.summary: Investigated several potential causes for the 502 errors, including disk full, CDN cache issues, and certificate expiration. None of these were the actual cause. The issue turned out to be an ingress idle timeout of 30 seconds. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing due to 47 malformed rows blocking the retry queue. Deleted these rows, unblocking the queue immediately. The root cause of the job failures needs further investigation.
